music.title: Clair de lune
music.pedal_basis: Editorial syncopated damper pedaling at opening harmonic/left-voice changes; the supplied Debussy MIDI has no CC64. After the opening, editorial bass-led pedal changes with holds capped at four seconds; not a transcription of the printed pedal markings.
music.adaptation: Complete MIDI piece, leading silence removed; all MIDI notes converted to timed JSON and editorial pedal/release added. No audio performance recording included.

music.title: Nocturne Op.9 No.2
music.pedal_basis: Audition pedal arrangement follows printed lower-staff ped/pes accompaniment group spans in Mutopia source, with brief lifts and delayed re-presses. After the opening, editorial bass-led pedal changes with holds capped at four seconds; not a transcription of the printed pedal markings.
music.adaptation: Complete MIDI piece, leading silence removed; all MIDI notes converted to timed JSON and editorial pedal/release added. No audio performance recording included.

music.title: Gymnopédie No.1
music.pedal_basis: Editorial syncopated damper pedaling at low accompaniment/bass changes for the audition.
music.adaptation: Complete MIDI piece, leading silence removed; all MIDI notes converted to timed JSON and editorial pedal/release added. No audio performance recording included.
